task: I get monthly electricity bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "electricity bill for MM/YY" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM/YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's electricity usage.
